name: Martin Villanueva
title: Developer & designer
bio: I build thoughtful, responsive web experiences. Manila-based developer open to freelance projects and early-career opportunities.
about: I'm Martin, a Manila-based developer with a designer's eye and a genuine curiosity for how things work. I care about more than getting a page on screen: I want to understand the problem, make the experience easy to use, and deliver reliable work people can build on. I'm open to junior software development roles, internships, and freelance collaborations. My experience includes React and TypeScript interfaces, quality assurance, cloud deployment preparation, and exploring machine learning through personal projects.

projects.name: AI-assisted HR screening workflow
projects.description: An n8n workflow using AI to support the initial HR screening process, with hiring decisions kept in human hands.
projects.details: Built an n8n workflow for AI-assisted initial HR screening. The workflow supports the early screening process and helps organize repetitive steps; it is intended to assist recruiters, not rank applicants or make hiring decisions. Human review remains central to evaluating candidates.

projects.name: DeepBreath
projects.description: Exploring how cough-sound analysis can help make early health insights more accessible.
projects.details: A research-driven concept exploring audio classification for preliminary pneumonia screening. Built an early model using a ResNet-34 architecture and logistic regression, then prepared a cloud staging environment on AWS for initial evaluation.

projects.name: Digital home

projects.details: A personal portfolio designed to bring software engineering and a visual design sensibility together. Made with React and TypeScript, with responsive layouts, motion details, and an editable content system.
